title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
source: Matrix using Final Cut Pro (SHN > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT)

ai_review.summary: A superb matrix mix captures a high‑energy 1982 show with soaring Space, Phil’s earthquake segment, Black Peter and tight first‑set classics.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as one of the band’s most inspired – a wild Space, an epic Phil “earthquake” rant, and standout renditions of Black Peter, Let It Grow, Playing in the Band and Eyes. The Hunter Seamons matrix mix is described as crystal‑clear with excellent keyboard texture, even if a few listeners note a slight sense of distance. Overall both the music and the recording are rated exceptionally high.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 4‑5 stars, consistently highlighting an outstanding show and a very high‑quality mix; minor comments about slight distance do not detract from the overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, detailed sound with great keyboard texture; some reviewers note a faint sense of distance compared to other Seamons mixes but overall the mix is clear and balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, cohesive first set that flows seamlessly into a second set highlighted by Playin' > Eyes and the epic Space/Earthquake sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice described as strong and mellowed with years of experience; guitar work implied to be on point throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: His “earthquake” rant during Space is repeatedly called epic and a major highlight.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard texture praised as great; Brent Mydland (referred to as Bobby) noted as right where he needs to be, reviving the band's direction.
